page.title: SLA policies
page.description: Promise how fast your team replies and resolves. Clocks run in open hours, warn ahead of each target and escalate on a breach.

list.title: Policies
list.description: Workflows apply a policy to conversations; new tickets follow the policy that names their type or priority.

targetHints.first_reply: From the customer's first message to the team's first reply.
targetHints.next_reply: From each later customer message to the team's answer.
targetHints.follow_up: After the team replies, how soon it follows up if the customer stays quiet.
targetHints.resolution: From the start of the conversation until it is resolved.

editor.newDescription: Set at least one target. Clocks start when a workflow applies the policy or a matching ticket is created.
editor.archivedDescription: Archived. Its clocks were canceled and nothing new follows it.
editor.missing: This SLA policy does not exist
editor.missingHint: It may belong to another workspace.

details.title: Details
details.name: Name
details.descriptionHint: Teammates read it where they pick a policy.

targetsSection.title: Targets
targetsSection.description: Each target is counted in the open hours of the schedule below. Leave one off to not track it.

clock.title: Clock
clock.warnHint: Raise an alert this long before a target is missed, for workflows to act on.
clock.scheduleHint: Clocks only count while this schedule is open.
clock.pauseCustomer: Pause while waiting on the customer
clock.pauseCustomerHint: Stop the clock while the ticket waits on the customer or the conversation is snoozed.
clock.pauseTeam: Pause while waiting on another team
clock.pauseTeamHint: Stop the clock while back-office work or a linked issue holds the ticket.

applies.title: Applies to
applies.description: New tickets of these types or with these priorities follow this policy. Leave both empty to apply it from workflows only.

breach.title: On breach
breach.description: What changes when a target is missed.
breach.priorityHint: Never lowers a priority that is already higher.
breach.teamHint: Reassign the conversation to this team; its assignee stays.

archive.title: Archive
archive.description: Stop using this policy. Its history stays on old conversations and tickets.
archive.confirmBody: Every clock it is running now is canceled, so those conversations and tickets lose their targets. New tickets and workflows no longer get it. This can't be undone.
